expectedSql.postgres: WITH RECURSIVE tree AS (SELECT category_id, category_id AS top_id FROM edge_cases.categories WHERE parent_category_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT k.category_id, t.top_id FROM edge_cases.categories k JOIN tree t ON k.parent_category_id = t.category_id) SELECT top.name AS department, COUNT(*) AS returned_lines FROM edge_cases.returns r JOIN edge_cases.order_lines l ON l.id = r.order_line_id JOIN edge_cases.products p ON p.id = l.product_id JOIN tree ON tree.category_id = p.category_id JOIN edge_cases.categories top ON top.category_id = tree.top_id WHERE r.returned_at >= '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z' AND r.returned_at < '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1
